summary: The SLₙ Chevalley relations are a fourth worked-example satellite around Layer 9's root-subgroup bullet while that bullet's own prerequisite stages (split reductive group schemes, pinnings, the Chevalley–Demazure construction) do not exist on main and the identical relations already exist for GLₙ. Single topic is fine; the relocation of the matrix transvection lemmas is forced by import direction.
